support.justification: The stipulated synthetic observation law is binary, taking exactly the values zero and one.

stationarity.justification: Stipulated stationary symmetric binary Markov law with flip probability 1/2; initial state is fair Bernoulli. Pseudorandom simulation approximates independent replicates of this mathematical model.

dependence.justification: For the stipulated stationary symmetric binary Markov law, beta(g)=(1/2)*abs(1-2*p)^g under supremum-over-events total variation; the Markov past/future reduction gives this exact coefficient.

design.provenance: Step 5 fixed protocol chosen before its scientific simulation runs; all cell settings and seed rules retained.

report.premises: Scientific support, strict stationarity and the dependence envelope are supplied assumptions. The layout, failure allocations, tolerance and candidate-setting rules are fixed without calibration-driven tuning; development-only learning is allowed. The numerical claims below are checked.
report.risk_target: stationary-law average normalized squared prediction error; unconditional coverage over the whole experiment
